title: Fixed-Wing Point Mass
text: Integrate fourth- or sixth-order point mass equations of motion in coordinated flight, 8 inputs, 11 outputs, {Units} sets Units Metric; {Reference frame orientation} sets the reference frames, {Degrees of freedom}, {Initial crossrange} sets the initial East, {Initial downrange} sets the initial North, {Initial altitude}, {Initial airspeed}, {Initial flight path angle}, {Initial heading angle} and {Mass} sets the point mass. Values come from the instance.
